evidence.observation: Pressure was 2.973 Torr with Ar at 99.8 sccm before growth.
Pressure rose to 3.18 Torr despite Ar remaining 99.9 sccm and temperature settling to 749.5 °C.
Pressure continued rising to 3.275 Torr at essentially unchanged flow and temperature (100.1 sccm, 749.6 °C), indicating a pressure/process deviation.
Required exhaust oxygen sensor is not installed; growth conditions are not fully verifiable, and no sample characterization is available.

args.missing_evidence: Expected growth-stage pressure profile and an independent pressure check; leak testing and exhaust-conductance checks to distinguish leakage from restriction; oxygen measurement to verify atmosphere purity; post-run sample characterization.
